plot_error_curves_plotly: plot training and test error curves using plotly and save the interactive chart to an HTML file
plot_error_curves_pyplot: plot training and test error curves using matplotlib and optionally save the static chart to a file
get_plot_colors: generate a list of distinct colors for plotting with support for pyplot or plotly color formats
prepare_plot_data: load JSON log files and extract epoch and metric data for training and test phases
review_plotting_module: review the plotting module functions for generating error curve visualizations from training logs
